root_cause.text: In the `io_ti` USB serial driver, the `build_i2c_fw_hdr()` function triggers a heap overflow because it copies data based on the untrusted `img_header->Length` field without verifying that the length fits within the remaining allocated buffer space before executing the `memcpy`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states the function "copies le16_to_cpu(img_header->Length) bytes into it without validating that Length fits within the available space," and the patch diff confirms the fix by adding a conditional check `if (le16_to_cpu(img_header->Length) > buffer_size - sizeof(struct ti_i2c_firmware_rec))` prior to the memory copy operation.
